The North Carolina public records are accessed through a unique identifier that is not related to either the NPI or the Medicaid CCN. There are a lot of facilities on the list that aren't ICF's -- they include group homes and other facilities, not just ICF's.

## Scrape NC public records links

Start here: <https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/searchpopup.asp> and just hit "Search" . There's no way to limit it to just ICF's.

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| include: false


library(httr2)
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(janitor)

```

```{r}
#| label: get-index
#| eval: false


response <- request("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/results.asp") |>
  req_method("POST") |>
  req_body_form(
    bUnsavedChanges = "False",
    cmbCounty = "ALL",
    txtcity = "",
    txtfacname = ""
  ) |>
  req_perform()


html <- response |>
  resp_body_html()

county_sections <- html |>
  html_elements("div.section")


parse_county <- function ( section ) {
    county <- section |>  html_element("h3") |> html_text2()
    table <- section |>  html_element("table.dataTable")
    facilities <- table |> html_table()
    links <- table |>  html_elements("a") |> html_attr("href")

    facilities |> 
        mutate ( county = county,
                 linkid = links |> str_extract("\\d+$"), 
                 site_zip = as.character(`Zip Code`) 
        ) |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

}

all_counties <- map ( county_sections, \(c) parse_county (c)) |> list_rbind()

saveRDS(all_counties, "nc_pub_records_links.RDS")
```

This is a list of all of the facilities, not just ICF's . We need to match this back to the ICF list. We don't think any have closed in recent years, so we don't have to worry about missing the ICFs.


## Match ICFs

Round 1: How well do they match by name and zip code? The matching columns are dba_name to name
and site_zip to zip_code

```{r}
#| label: match-exact
#| eval: false


standardize_name <- function ( orig) {
    orig |> 
        str_to_lower() |> 
        str_replace_all ("[.,-/#&]", " ") |> 
        str_replace_all("[']", "") |> 
        str_squish() |> 
        str_trim()

}
```

Get the license list:

```{r}

icf_nc  <- readxl::read_excel("icfmr.xlsx") |> 
    janitor::clean_names() 


```



```{r}



match_counties <- readRDS("nc_pub_records_links.RDS") |> 
  rename_with ( \(x) str_c( "pr_", x)) |> 
  rename  ( pr_zip = pr_site_zip) |> 
  mutate ( clean_pr_name = standardize_name(pr_name))
  
## Add the government ones

govt_icfs <- tibble (
              ccn_number = c( "34G001", "34G002", "34G003", "34G004", "34G159") ,
              dba_name = c("Caswell Center", "Murdoch Developmental Center", "J. Iverson Riddle", "O'Berry Neuro-Medical", "Carolina Living and Learning") ,
              site_city = c("Kinston", "Butner", "Morganton", "Goldsboro", "Pittsboro"), 
              site_zip = c("28501", "27509", "28655", "27530", "27312"), 
              county = c("Lenoir", "Granville", "Burke", "Wayne", "Chatham") , 
              pr_linkid = c("955755", "955757", "955760", "955758", "921564")
       )  |> 
        mutate ( licensee = "State of NC",
                 nc_pub_recs_link =  glue("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/facility.asp?fid={pr_linkid}")
      )


link_index <- 
  icf_nc |> 
  select ( row_no, license_number, ccn_number, dba_name, licensee = name_of_licensee_legal_name, site_city, site_zip, county) |> 
  mutate ( clean_dba_name = standardize_name ( dba_name)) |> 
  left_join ( match_counties, 
              join_by ( clean_dba_name==clean_pr_name, site_zip == pr_zip) , 
              relationship="many-to-many"
            ) |> 
  mutate ( nc_pub_recs_link = glue("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/facility.asp?fid={pr_linkid}"))   |> 
  add_row ( govt_icfs) |> 
  distinct ( pr_linkid, .keep_all=TRUE)   







```


## Get the pages 

First, I think they are blocking automated scripting on the page. Check it: 

```{r}
#| label: test-page-download
#| eval: false

download_webpage <- function(url, output_file = "page.html", delay = 2) {
  
  # Add a delay to be respectful to the server
  Sys.sleep(delay)
  
  # Create request with realistic browser headers
  response <- request(url) |>
    req_user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36") |>
    req_headers(
      "Accept" = "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8",
      "Accept-Language" = "en-US,en;q=0.5",
      "Accept-Encoding" = "gzip, deflate, br",
      "DNT" = "1",
      "Connection" = "keep-alive",
      "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests" = "1"
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_throttle(rate = 1) |>
    req_perform()
  
  # Extract and save the HTML content
  html_content <- resp_body_string(response)
  writeLines(html_content, output_file)
  
  # message("Page successfully saved to: ", output_file)
  
  return(invisible(output_file))
}




```


Retreive every page and save it into the inspection_pages subfolder


```{r}
#| label: retrieve-pages
#| eval: false

pageids <- unique(link_index$pr_linkid)
govt_pageids <- link_index |>  filter ( licensee == "State of NC") |> pull( pr_linkid)


for (p in govt_pageids) {
  tmp_in <- glue("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/facility.asp?fid={p}")
  tmp_out <- glue("inspection_pages/i{p}.html")
  download_webpage( tmp_in, output_file = tmp_out)
  Sys.sleep( runif( 1, .25, 2))

}



```


## Parse into a data table



Example file: 942020


```{r}
#| label: get-headers-function

get_header <- function(html) {
  
  facility_name <- html |> 
    html_element("h3") |> 
    html_text()
  
  address <- html |> 
    html_element("td p") |> 
    html_text() |> 
    str_trim()
  
  td_p_elements <- html |> html_elements("td p")
  
  mailing_address <- if (length(td_p_elements) >= 2) {
    td_p_elements |> pluck(2) |> html_text() |> str_trim()
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  
  contact_info <- if (length(td_p_elements) >= 3) {
    td_p_elements |> pluck(3) |> html_text() |> str_trim()
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
  
  programs <- tryCatch({
    html |> 
      html_element("table.program") |> 
      html_table() |> 
      mutate(type = str_c(`Program code`, `Services`, sep = " - ")) |> 
      summarize(programs = str_c(`Program code`, collapse = "; ")) |> 
      pull(programs)
  }, error = function(e) NA_character_)
  
  tibble(
    pr_facility_name = facility_name,
    site_addr = address,
    mailing_addr = mailing_address,
    contact = contact_info,
    categories = programs
  )
}

```

```{r}
#| label: get-doc-list-function

get_details <- function (html) {

 documents <- html |> 
  html_element("table.facility") |> 
  html_table() |> 
  rename(
    inspection_type = `Inspection Type`,
    document_type = `Document Type`,
    inspection_date_txt = `Inspection Date`,
    pages = Pages 
  )

  doc_links <- html |> 
    html_element("table.facility") |> 
    html_elements("a") |> 
    html_attr("href") |> 
    str_remove("^.*sods/")

  #depends on doc_links being same length vector as the number of rows in documents
  documents |>  mutate ( doc_link_id = doc_links)

}


```


Test it: 

```{r}
#| label: test-getdata



id <- "921564"
html<- read_html(glue("inspection_pages/i{id}.html"))

header <- get_header(html) 
header["facility_linkid"] <- id
```

```{r}

  
docs <- get_details(html) |> 
  mutate  ( annual = str_detect ( inspection_type, "Annual"), 
            complaint = str_detect (inspection_type, "Complaint"),
            followup = str_detect( inspection_type, "Follow-up")
        )
        
```



```{r}
#| label: get-html-tables



doc_names <- list.files( path="inspection_pages", pattern="*.html")
all_doclist <- list()

for ( i in seq_along(doc_names) ) {
  
  page <- doc_names[i]
  pageid <- str_extract( page, "\\d+") 

  html <- read_html( glue("inspection_pages/{page}"))
  header_row <- get_header(html)
  
  doc_df <- get_details( html) |> 
    mutate  ( annual = str_detect( inspection_type, "Annual"), 
            complaint = str_detect(inspection_type, "Complaint"),
            followup = str_detect( inspection_type, "Follow-up"), 
            fac_pageid = pageid, 
            doc_link = glue("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/{doc_link_id}") |>  as.character(), 
            inspection_date = mdy(inspection_date_txt)
         ) |> 
    cross_join ( header_row)

  all_doclist[[i]] <- doc_df 
    
}


all_docs <- 
  list_rbind(all_doclist)


```


Get it back together with the licensing data



```{r}

master_nc_pubrecs_index <- 
  link_index |> 
  select ( license_number, ccn_number, licensee, dba_name, site_city, site_zip, county, pr_linkid, nc_pub_recs_link) |> 
  inner_join (all_docs, join_by ( pr_linkid == fac_pageid) ) |> 

  mutate ( pr_link = glue('=HYPERLINK("{nc_pub_recs_link}", "{license_number}")' ), 
           doc_id = str_extract ( doc_link_id, "\\d{4}/[-0-9]+"),
           doc_link = glue('=HYPERLINK("{doc_link}", "Link to doc")')
  ) 
  
  
  
```




Clean the licensee data: 

```{r}

count ( master_nc_pubrecs_index, licensee)


```
